flags.description: List of sslscan command-line flags (e.g., --verbose, --show-certificate, --no-colour). Each item corresponds to a boolean or flag-style option found in the man page.

targets.description: List of target hosts to scan. Can include ports (e.g., host:port). If empty, sslscan expects targets to be provided differently or will run interactively (though automation usually requires explicit targets).
